source_scope: 30-file private Ingest corpus; public nonrestricted source references only
method: Terms in source. Anchors checked against Word source bytes by private local verifier; presence proves text occurrence only, not claim truth, causal derivation, efficacy or legal status.

claims.statement: Four named ethical principles guide the martial discipline, including guarding life over ego and treating skill as a sacred responsibility.

source.locator: I. Core Ethos and Philosophical Grounding

claims.limitation: Values stated by the author, not demonstrated training outcomes.

claims.statement: The five Sashes of Dawn provide the authored martial rank vocabulary; a black-belt label is not the system's own terminal rank.

source.locator: II. Rank Structure – Sashes of Dawn

claims.limitation: Rank descriptions do not establish certification or existing instructors.

claims.statement: The five SURGE pillars are Shock, Unbalance, Reversal, Grapple and Environment.
claims.limitation: Source taxonomy, not validated combat efficacy.

claims.statement: The Rule of Tens constrains the main technical vocabulary per SURGE pillar.
claims.limitation: A design convention, not evidence a proposed technique is safe.

claims.statement: The main manual includes an ethical force-escalation framework.
claims.limitation: Not a statement of legal self-defense authority.

claims.statement: The main martial manual contains a longer Curriculum Lattice as well as a more accelerated implementation.
claims.limitation: The editorial eight-week student standard is a later approved harmonization.

claims.statement: The student SURGE manual places Phase 1 at weeks 1–8 with four training days per week.
claims.limitation: Calendar does not prove readiness or physical safety.

claims.statement: The student manual places Phase 2 at weeks 9–16 and Phase 3 at weeks 17–24.
claims.limitation: Higher weekly frequency remains optional/individualized in application.

claims.statement: The Guardian's Path appears as the continuing fourth/mastery phase rather than a fixed endpoint.
claims.limitation: Elapsed months alone do not confer rank or teaching authority.

claims.statement: The first-phase mental-conditioning source organizes five days by pillar-centered themes.
claims.limitation: Physiological efficacy is not established by source text.

claims.statement: The camp source describes regulatory, staffing, activity, emergency and psychological-safety planning needs.
claims.limitation: No camp operating status or licensing follows from a plan.

claims.statement: The Church package contains identity and broad doctrine, governance drafts and voluntary spiritual-practice sections.
claims.limitation: The author's current umbrella characterization is a separate direct clarification.

claims.statement: The Church package includes draft Indiana nonprofit articles and bylaws.
claims.limitation: A draft is not an established filing, registration or approval.

claims.statement: The full True Ascension guide has seven principal sections ranging from cosmology to a concluding account of spiritual return.
claims.limitation: Source-authored metaphysical concepts, not external evidence.

claims.statement: The plain-language edition enumerates six Aeons with symbolic interpretations.
claims.limitation: The symbols are part of teaching material, not clinical stages.

claims.statement: The plain-language edition names Ignorance, Desire, Fear, False Revelation, Control and Demiurge as blockers or enclosing systems.
claims.limitation: These labels do not establish supernatural entities or diagnoses.

claims.statement: The full guide includes a distinct Shadow Walker chapter.
claims.limitation: Metaphorical/spiritual framework, not an objective personality type.

claims.statement: The Book of Signs has seven named modern signs.

anchors: The Seven Modern Signs of the Ascended

claims.limitation: The source explicitly frames the signs as lived acts, not literal magic.

claims.statement: The Book of Signs groups twelve named reflective methods under Emotional Repatterning, Somatic Liberation and Erotic Sovereignty.
claims.limitation: The source's 'healing' labels are not clinical efficacy claims.

claims.statement: The Book of Signs includes separate short confrontation protocols.
claims.limitation: Interpersonal labels cannot determine a third party's motives.

claims.statement: The Book of Signs concludes with five named Resurrection Templates.
claims.limitation: Ritual/metaphorical terminology, not a medical resurrection claim.

claims.statement: The short Aeon Key contains five self-reflection modules beginning with Clear the Static and ending with Step Outside the Noise.
claims.limitation: It is voluntary reflective writing.

claims.statement: The longer Aeon Key workbook adds journaling prompts and note spaces to its five modules.
claims.limitation: Word/PDF pair requires distinct edition tracking.

claims.statement: The Confrontation Scripts Appendix indexes 25 named interpersonal-pattern scripts.
claims.limitation: Scripts are not proof of diagnosis or malicious intent in any particular person.

claims.statement: The complete Shadow Walkers roadmap has six major sections, including the cosmic landscape, Aeonic journey and final reflections.
claims.limitation: Thematic reuse does not prove chronological authorship or direct descent.

claims.statement: The student training manual identifies Phase 2 as Pillar Integration across weeks 9–16, scheduled five days per week.
claims.limitation: An authored timetable, not universal safety or readiness evidence.

claims.statement: Phase 2 gives each of the five SURGE pillars its own weekly day.
claims.limitation: The public course replaces potentially injurious examples with safer conceptual learning.

claims.statement: The source describes Environment training as an explicit new component in Phase 2.

anchors: Phase 2 is the student’s first real exposure

claims.limitation: Does not authorize unqualified confined-space or ambush demonstrations.

claims.statement: The student manual identifies Phase 3 as Dynamic Application, weeks 17–24, six days per week.
claims.limitation: Authored schedule only, with no observed training outcomes.

claims.statement: Phase 3 includes a sixth integration and sparring theme after five pillar-focused themes.

source.locator: Part I, Phase 3 weekly training structure

claims.limitation: No implicit permission to use contact, weapons or surprise exposure.

claims.statement: The source explicitly embeds an ethical-pressure-testing topic involving restraint and bystanders.

source.locator: Part I, Phase 3, Ethical Pressure Testing

claims.limitation: Learning objectives do not establish safe field performance.

claims.statement: The mastery manual presents Phase 4 as continuous development and Guardian's Path rather than terminal calendar completion.
claims.limitation: Guardian stage is not proof of rank, credentials, operation or appointment.

claims.statement: The Phase 4 teaching apprenticeship describes early assistant teaching under supervision and later limited lesson leadership.
claims.limitation: Proposed progression, not an existing staffed school or licensing authority.

claims.statement: The source includes a philosophical and spiritual integration component parallel to technical learning in Phase 4.

source.locator: Part II, Philosophical and Spiritual Integration

claims.limitation: Spiritual analogies are optional and cannot be imposed as an assessment gate.

claims.statement: The Phase 1 mental conditioning manual organizes pillar-related reflection and breathing themes through a distinct fifth Environment day.
claims.limitation: Source's biomedical and trauma-related mechanism claims remain unverified.
